subject: sociology

moments.title: Family, Socialization and Interaction Process
moments.body: Parsons describes the nuclear family as 'isolated' and specialising in primary socialisation and stabilisation of adult personalities.
moments.takeaway: Functionalism cast the nuclear family as adapted to industrial society.

moments.title: Critiques begin
moments.body: Empirical studies document continued extended-family ties, challenging Parsons's isolation thesis.

moments.title: Sex, Gender and Society
moments.body: Oakley distinguishes sex (biological) from gender (cultural), challenging functionalist accounts of gendered roles.
moments.takeaway: Feminist sociology reshaped how the family was theorised.

now.title: Family diversity
now.body: Single-parent, blended, same-sex, and chosen families are central to modern sociology of personal life (Carol Smart).
now.open_questions: How do gender, work and care reconfigure as families diversify?

reflection: The 'standard' nuclear family is a brief mid-20th-century arrangement.
